summary: Tested the DEFAULT JOB ALERTS feature and the email background/cron fix, backend and frontend. Backend: the new tests/test_job_alerts.py passes 15/15. The full /app/backend/tests suite (PACE_N=3) passes 83/83 after 4 outdated assertions were updated to the new semantics. Verified: (1) Consent has three states. A registered user with no preference has no job_alert_consent field. Saving the profile without touching alerts keeps it missing, in both the API and the UI (checked in Mongo; no consent_records doc is written). sp-alert-off then sp-save stores false and writes a consent_records doc. No candidate has an implicit false without a consent_records entry. (2) Share rules. A no-preference user gets in-app 'sent' and email 'skipped' with an opt-in reason. An opted-in user gets in-app sent plus one logged email attempt. An opted-out user is skipped ('candidate opted out of job alerts') and has no job_notifications. A low-relevance match (score 10) is skipped ('low relevance (score 10 < 50)'). An unapproved match is skipped. A second share is skipped as 'already sent'. Opting out after a share hides the notifications. (3) /smartmatch/notifications and /smartmatch/me: the shared item shows for no-preference users and is empty for opted-out users. (4) Alert Manager APIs: jobs (notified/approved counts), recipients, received=yes/no filters and the alert_pref/profile filters all work. Candidates get 403, unauthenticated requests get 401. (5) The sma-alert-prefs analytics match DB counts in both the API and the UI. (6) Register returns in under 5s with the welcome email in the background. Cron /api/cron/email-retry returns 401 for a bad or missing token and 200 {accepted, queued<=8} with the secret. UI, end to end: the Alert Manager sidebar nav, the job select, Find Matching Candidates and all 6 recipient filters return correct sets (opted_out lists only the opted-out user). Approve, then Send alert (in-app is the default, email unchecked) gives 'sent (in_app)'. The received view shows Delivered/Unread, then Read after the candidate clicks. The candidate dashboard-notifications card shows '1 new'; clicking it goes to the job. /matches shows the Shared tab and Recommended containing the job, plus the notice text. The opted-out candidate sees the 'You turned off job alerts' messages and Shared (0). SmartMatch Control Room, Match Review and Alerts & Templates pages load. The email provider was quota-limited (429) for the whole run, so welcome, announcement and retry emails were logged as failed-with-retry_html, which is expected.

minor.issue: The filter is retry_count {$not:{$gte:3}}. A failed log with retry_count 0/1/2 is re-sent, so one email can be sent up to 4 times in total (the original plus 3 retries). If 'max 3 attempts' means 3 total sends, use $lt 2, or count the original send.
The response field 'sent' equals 'queued' even though nothing has been sent yet (the work is in the background). This is misleading; consider dropping 'sent' or renaming it.
This counts sent + failed (attempted), but the label says 'Notifications sent'. Consider renaming it to 'Notifications attempted'.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows still show Approve / Reject / Mark pending review / Comment actions, so the view is not actually read-only. Share is skipped by the backend, but approve is allowed. Hide the row actions and bulk buttons when rf === 'opted_out'.

The 'N matched · N approved · N received in-app' line and the dropdown counts do not refresh after approve or share in the MatchTable (the am-jobs query is not invalidated). They stay at 0 approved / 0 received until a reload.

issues: From/To filters still use the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn calendar (carried over from the earlier report).

action_items: Make the Alert Manager 'Opted out (view only)' filter actually read-only (hide approve/reject/share actions and bulk buttons)
Invalidate the ['am-jobs'] query after review/share in the Alert Manager (or pass an onChange callback into MatchTable)
Clarify the max-attempts semantics in cron_email_retry (currently up to 1 original + 3 retries)
tests/test_jobradar_api.py and tests/test_tracker_demand.py leave TEST users behind (test_<hex>@example.com, test_trk_<hex>@example.com). Add teardown cleanup.
tests/test_email_pacing.py sends a TEST_ announcement to ALL candidates, including the seeded test@jobradar.com. Consider scoping the announcement endpoint or the test to TEST recipients only.
critical_code_review_comments: smartmatch.py is 1071 lines and server.py is 1850 lines, above the 700-line guideline; split alert-manager/notifications and the email/cron code into modules

match_query alert_pref/profile filters load all candidates (to_list(50000)) and filter in Python. That is fine at this size but will not scale; for alert_pref, push the tri-state into a Mongo query ($exists/$eq).
The analytics endpoint also loads all users, matches and notifications into memory
/auth/profile cannot reset consent to 'no preference' (None is filtered out). That is consistent with the spec (only on/off are offered), but noted.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_smartmatch.py (skip reason now 'opted out' because register-with-false means explicit opt-out)
/app/backend/tests/test_email_pacing.py (poll for background welcome logs; accept failed-with-retry under provider quota; dedupe count includes failed-with-retry)

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Four regression failures came from outdated test expectations, not app bugs: (a) the opted-out reason text changed; (b) welcome email is now in the background, so the log appears later; (c) dedupe now counts failed-with-retry recipients; (d) the provider returns 429, so 'all sent' is impossible. The tests were updated.
